reviews.text:
Enquired about dog training got the most unprofessional response . I leave it at that but if you've no interest in doing business just close your site don't advertise your courses.
The company literally said nothing available now or in the near future.. Seriously...
Not a pleasant man to deal with tends to throw the toys out of the pram if you have a difference of opinion. Better value to be had elsewhere in my opinion.

John and Dermo know their business like few others. This must be one of the oldest and well established of it's kind around Dublin if not the country. Expert advice with plenty of banter to boot and all for a reasonable price. It's also get to see a place run by people who care so much!!
I have to say this is the best kennel in North Dublin area, Gerry help us while we traveling, they are kind people for everyone and every pers, thanks for everything.👍 …

John Ward changed the life of my very nervous labrador x collie (Alex) by teaching her agility and obedience.
With John’s expertise and patience Alex went on to have a very happy life and reached competition standard at both agility and obedience.
I’ve since brought all of my dogs to John for training.
John is super and I highly recommend him.
